SELECT customer_id, customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE is_active = TRUE
  AND region = 'North';

SELECT order_id
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS completed_order_value FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders_with_home_product
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.category = 'home'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name

SELECT c.region, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.completed_order_count, 0)::numeric), 2) AS average_completed_orders_per_customer FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS net_value
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY net_value DESC, o.customer_id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT event_id, vehicle_id
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::numeric >= 100
SELECT v.depot_id, ROUND(AVG(f.liters * f.price_per_liter), 2) AS rounded_average_fuel_purchase_cost FROM fuel_events AS f JOIN vehicles AS v ON f.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.depot_id

SELECT r.route_id, r.route_code, r.route_name, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS average_kilometres_per_litre FROM routes AS r JOIN trips AS t ON t.route_id = r.route_id GROUP BY r.route_id, r.route_code, r.route_name

SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_event_count
FROM vehicles AS v
LEFT JOIN maintenance_events AS m
  ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
 AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
       - INTERVAL '30 days'
 AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
GROUP BY v.vehicle_id
ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

SELECT d.driver_id, d.driver_name, COUNT(t.trip_id) AS cargo_trip_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN trips AS t ON t.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN vehicles AS v ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id
WHERE v.vehicle_class = 'cargo'
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name
HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) >= 1

SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_telemetry_timestamp, t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}' AS engine_temperature_c
FROM vehicles AS v
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id)
           vehicle_id,
           event_at,
           payload
    FROM telemetry_events
    ORDER BY vehicle_id, event_at DESC, event_id DESC
) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
ORDER BY v.vehicle_id;

SELECT r.route_id, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS average_km_per_litre FROM trips AS t JOIN routes AS r ON t.route_id = r.route_id GROUP BY r.route_id ORDER BY average_km_per_litre DESC, r.route_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, COUNT(st.ticket_id) FILTER (WHERE st.priority = 'urgent') AS urgent_ticket_count
FROM accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS st ON st.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name
ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT t.ticket_id, t.account_id, t.opened_at, r.first_response_at, sp.first_response_sla_hours, r.first_response_at - t.opened_at AS first_response_time FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.account_id) s.account_id, s.plan_id FROM subscriptions AS s ORDER BY s.account_id, s.starts_on DESC, s.subscription_id DESC) AS latest_sub ON latest_sub.account_id = a.account_id JOIN service_plans AS sp ON sp.plan_id = latest_sub.plan_id JOIN (SELECT t2.ticket_id, MIN(e.event_at) AS first_response_at FROM support_tickets AS t2 JOIN ticket_events AS e ON e.ticket_id = t2.ticket_id WHERE e.event_type = 'agent_response' AND e.event_at > t2.opened_at GROUP BY t2.ticket_id) AS r ON r.ticket_id = t.ticket_id WHERE r.first_response_at > t.opened_at + sp.first_response_sla_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour'

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS urgent_ticket_share FROM accounts AS a JOIN support_tickets AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, tc.ticket_count
FROM accounts AS a
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM support_tickets
    GROUP BY account_id
) AS tc ON tc.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE tc.ticket_count > (
    SELECT AVG(ticket_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
        FROM support_tickets
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) AS counts
)
ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM accounts AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM support_tickets AS t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending')
)
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM incidents AS i
    WHERE i.account_id = a.account_id
      AND i.severity = 'high'
);
